svg.text: ls_up_fs: fail-safe 1.2 V -> 3.3 V level shifter that needs no 1.2 V supply (sg13_hv)
x = NOT in: N1 (1u/0.45u, gate in) pulls x low. The leaker PL10 ... PL1 (10 x 0.3u/20u in series, gates on in)
pulls x high while in = 0 (full gate drive) and is 2 ... 5 x weaker than N1 while in = 1.2 V.
PF (0.3u/5u, gate y) latches x high once y is low: hysteresis, and it holds x against the leakage of N1.
y = NOT x = in at 3.3 V (XI1), out_b = NOT y (XI2), out = NOT out_b (XI3).
in: a valid 1.2 V level from an always-on rail (the harness enable, dig_in), also while the slot vdd_1v2 is off.
Static current only while in = 1: the leaker, 28 ... 92 nA. vddh / vss: 3.3 V rail of the circuit using the shifter.
